subject_session: sub-Rat1 / ses-19980425T124500 (Rat 1, Flight Day 9), baseline epoch
stated_limitation: This session has a modest number of well-isolated units and only ~34 minutes of continuous open-field locomotion, so statistical power is limited

justification.dataset: CA1 tetrode data is the right region, but a microgravity spaceflight recording with patchy tracking is a hard, non-standard substrate where clean CA1 place-cell datasets (000044 etc.) exist and the effect is only marginally present.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with thoughtful, well-justified position cleaning (dropout code removal, zero-order-hold collapse) and speed thresholding, though no unit-isolation quality filtering.
justification.analysis: Skaggs information with a per-unit circular-shift null is the right method, but the population claim depends on distinguishing from chance and there is no multiple-comparison correction or binomial test on the significant count.
justification.correctness: Numbers roughly reproduce in spirit but the README (2 significant, unit 10 p=0.008) contradicts the committed figure (3 significant, unit 10 p=0.014), an unseeded internal inconsistency.
justification.figures: Figures are readable and labeled, but the shuffle histogram shows observed and null nearly overlapping, and the chosen 'significant' examples are diffuse non-place-cells or occupancy artifacts, so they do not make the case.
justification.honesty: A chance-level result is presented as 'consistent with genuine hippocampal place cells,' with unit 10's occupancy-artifact corner called a 'textbook place field' and diffuse units labeled significant — multiple disqualifying acts cap this at 1.
justification.verdict: The headline conclusion is a chance-level finding dressed up as a positive demonstration with unrepresentative examples, so a rotation student would be asked to start over.
